entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm.>> Oh, sing to the LORD a new song! For He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have gained Him the victory.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: The LORD has made known His salvation; His righteousness He has revealed in the sight of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 98:3
segments: He has remembered His mercy and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 98:4
segments: ¶Shout joyfully to the LORD, all the earth; Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises.

entries.title: Psalms 98:5
segments: Sing to the LORD with the harp, With the harp and the sound of a psalm,

entries.title: Psalms 98:6
segments: With trumpets and the sound of a horn; Shout joyfully before the LORD, the King.

entries.title: Psalms 98:7
segments: Let the sea roar, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell in it;

entries.title: Psalms 98:8
segments: Let the rivers clap [their] hands; Let the hills be joyful together

entries.title: Psalms 98:9
segments: before the LORD, (98:9) For He is coming to judge the earth. With righteousness He shall judge the world, And the peoples with equity.
